title: Maximum Depth of N-ary Tree
goal: Solve Maximum Depth of N-ary Tree: Given an n-ary tree, find its maximum depth. The maximum depth is the number of nodes along the longest path from the root node to the farthest leaf node.
strategy: Given an n-ary tree, find its maximum depth. The maximum depth is the number of nodes along the longest path from the root node to the farthest leaf node.
